semantic.justification: Original ParseString default/copy policy, actual cell/formula/shared-string construction, apostrophe handling, preset Text, original date-edit locale/evaluation handling, original type compatibility and overwrite rules, simple/scientific input flags and SpecialNumberOnly text formatting. Uses actual formatter/pattern/pool/cell owners, not CSV heuristics. Full native differential, ABI and broader CSV output acceptance remain pending. Restored original document/table/column SetString parse-and-release chain and single-cell shared-group listener teardown using the actual formatter, policies, cell values, stores and listeners. Single-line SetTextCell uses the supplied ScSetStringParam or original setTextInput defaults. Cell-value string commit/release uses SetString instead of promoting newline-bearing string variants through SetTextCell. Edit release transfers the exact object without Clone/destruction; nullable edit arguments and rejected-destination destruction follow source unique_ptr semantics. Column release forwards listening modes and content-only DeleteContent preserves text attributes. Existing unrepresented formula-group compute/stream-cache services are not replaced with fake callbacks; full native module/allocator/thread/cache QA and original multiline EditEngine generation remain unverified/incomplete. No UI save/autosave/recovery policy changes.
